description.value: Cloverdale Country Market is a locally-owned, award-winning organic specialty grocer in Surrey's Cloverdale neighbourhood, voted best produce store for 15 consecutive years by local shoppers. The market sells fresh fruits and vegetables sourced from its own family farm and local BC growers, alongside an extensive organic section, gluten-free groceries, full-service gourmet deli, and freshly baked goods. An on-site Garden Bistro serves Nespresso coffee, hot soups, grilled paninis, and ice cream, making it a well-rounded stop for a touring cyclist needing real food.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, open, year-round business at the OSM address with the same phone number. The site consistently uses 'Cloverdale Country Market' rather than OSM's 'Cloverdale Country Farm Market' — a minor name discrepancy worth flagging. No mention of bike parking or water refill anywhere in the website content; basic groceries and hot food are both clearly confirmed by the About and Deli/Bistro subpages.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM has 'Cloverdale Country Farm Market' but the website consistently uses 'Cloverdale Country Market' across all pages including the address footer and page titles.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round specialty grocer with deli and bistro — a genuinely useful food stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley corridor.

Hot food.detail: Garden Bistro serves freshly grilled paninis, soups, and gourmet sub sandwiches; baked goods made in-house daily
